specs.Source: Institute for Supply Management ( latest release )
specs.Measures: Level of a diffusion index based on surveyed purchasing managers, excluding the manufacturing industry
specs.Usual Effect: 'Actual' greater than 'Forecast' is good for currency
specs.Frequency: Released monthly, on the third business day after the month ends
specs.FF Notes: Above 50.0 indicates industry expansion, below indicates contraction. Source changed series from unadjusted to seasonally adjusted as of January 2001. Source changed series calculation formula as of Feb 2008
specs.Why Traders Care: It's a leading indicator of economic health - businesses react quickly to market conditions, and their purchasing managers hold perhaps the most current and relevant insight into the company's view of the economy
specs.Derived Via: Survey of about 300 purchasing managers which asks respondents to rate the relative level of business conditions including employment, production, new orders, prices, supplier deliveries, and inventories
specs.Also Called: Non-Manufacturing PMI, Non-Manufacturing ISM Report On Business
specs.Acro Expand: The Institute for Supply Management (ISM), Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI)

specs.Measures: The number of individuals who filed for unemployment insurance for the first time during the past week
specs.Usual Effect: 'Actual' less than 'Forecast' is good for currency
specs.Frequency: Released weekly, usually on the first Thursday after the week ends
specs.FF Notes: This is the nation's earliest economic data. The market impact fluctuates from week to week - there tends to be more focus on the release when traders need to diagnose recent developments, or when the reading is at extremes
specs.Why Traders Care: Although it's generally viewed as a lagging indicator, the number of unemployed people is an important signal of overall economic health because consumer spending is highly correlated with labor-market conditions. Unemployment is also a major consideration for those steering the country's monetary policy

specs.Measures: Level of a composite index based on surveyed consumers
specs.Usual Effect: 'Actual' greater than 'Forecast' is good for currency
specs.Frequency: Released monthly, around the middle of the current month
specs.FF Notes: There are 2 versions of this data released 14 days apart – Preliminary and Revised. The Preliminary release is the earlier and thus tends to have the most impact
specs.Why Traders Care: Financial confidence is a leading indicator of consumer spending, which accounts for a majority of overall economic activity
specs.Derived Via: Survey of about 420 consumers which asks respondents to rate the relative level of current and future economic conditions

specs.Measures: Percentage that consumers expect the price of goods and services to change during the next 12 months
specs.Usual Effect: 'Actual' greater than 'Forecast' is good for currency
specs.Frequency: Released monthly, around the middle of the current month
specs.FF Notes: There are 2 versions of this data released 14 days apart – Preliminary and Revised. The Preliminary release is the earlier and thus tends to have the most impact
specs.Why Traders Care: Expectations of future inflation can manifest into real inflation, primarily because workers tend to push for higher wages when they believe prices will rise
specs.Derived Via: Survey of about 420 consumers which asks respondents where they expect prices to be 12 months in the future
